phantom_key_mask.why: zero-padded K rows make the phantom scores exactly 0; exp(0 - shift) would add 1.0 to every denominator row

math.row_broadcast: explicit per-row vector_dup expansion (no implicit broadcast); the Half-representable shift uses the exact native uint16 copy + Half transpose path

shift_fold.order: pairwise Half vec_max in the same 3+4 stage pattern as the denominator fold; max is exact under any association

doubled_buffers: score Float (also exp, also low residual)
memory.removed_round99_buffer: separate Float low-residual score tile (16384 B)

Tensor.reshape((n1,MB,16)) is a metadata view of the same flat UB buffer
masked vector_dup(repeat_times=n1, blk_stride=1, rep_stride=2*MB=128) writes one 16-value NZ row slot per group; 128 is inside the 8-bit immediate
Scalar.set_as(<UB element>) is a legal UB-to-scalar load
h_reduce_sum on Float compiles to Float vcadd; h_max to Float vmax
the 8-group Half fold is emitted as explicit vec_max calls, because the high-level h_max rejected the inferred step of a sliced NZ tensor in Round99

in-place same-shape h_sub/h_mul/h_add/h_exp with dst==src0 is supported
a Float UB buffer can be reused sequentially (score->exp->low residual, Half score->P_hi, row expansion->widened P_hi) without an explicit alias API

h_cast of -FLT_MAX to Half saturates rather than producing NaN; the phantom mask is still correct if it saturates to -inf, because every real scaled score is above -16384 so max() selects a real value
a dynamic if_scope (no else_scope) around only vector_dup phantom fills does not re-trigger the Round99 high-level if/else canonicalisation crash
a 32 KiB single tensor_mov L0C->UB burst is legal (Round85 executed a 64 KiB single burst of the same form)
